no_usable_file: No usable file in the selection.
refused_recompute: {reason}; {excuse}, the unit will be computed on my machines
excuse_old_unit: unit created by an AIODOS version from before October 21, 2026, so there is no knowing whether the file has changed since
excuse_file_changed: the file has changed since it was handed to them
excuse_reader: their document reader may differ from mine
vector_count_mismatch: Ollama did not return as many vectors as passages
sample_mismatch: passage {number} recomputed here: similarity {similarity}, at least {minimum} expected
refused_uncheckable: text computed by a friend for an image, a sound, a video, a web page or a format this machine cannot read back: impossible to check here, the unit will be computed on my machines
refused_unreadable: document unreadable here ({error}): impossible to check a friend's result, the unit will be computed on my machines
skipped_by_friend: document skipped by the friend although it has text when read here
passage_not_in_document: a returned passage is not in the document as read here
passages_cut_differently: passages split differently from here (cherry-picked pieces, omissions or repetitions)
passage_too_long: passage longer than {max} characters: the splitting never makes such long ones
invalid_vector_count: vectors missing, or not as many as the passages
wrong_dimension: vectors of dimension {got} instead of {expected} (different embedding model?)
reindex_summary: Model: {model}. Library items recomputed: {items} (re-read from their file: {reread}); conversations rebuilt in memory: {conversations}.
